svg.title: Every configuration on one plane
svg.desc: Each of 18 configurations beside 24 agent sessions of the traces with the largest contexts, at the median of its runs with their range, the agents' tokens a second over the calls' first 240 s against the voice-to-voice p95 on a log scale and the SLO of 2.02 s, only the engine change and the router that aborts agent requests coming near it: Tuned vLLM 10.14 s at 3,552 tokens/s; SMG 11.05 s at 3,446 tokens/s; llm-d (emulated) 10.99 s at 3,684 tokens/s; SGLang with HiCache 11.95 s at 4,330 tokens/s; the abort-and-resubmit router 2.59 s at 3,593 tokens/s; the change 2.19 s at 3,362 tokens/s; the lifecycle policy 10.99 s at 3,633 tokens/s; vLLM's queued-token limit at least 30 s at 5,584 tokens/s.
